title: PROPOSED Expansion Budget FY2027 (Under Board Committee Review)
summary: Unapproved draft budget proposal exploring a $1.2M capital expansion project.
content: This draft proposal outlines a prospective $1,200,000 capital expansion campaign for a permanent community building in Minneapolis. This proposal has NOT been reviewed or ratified by the Board of Directors and represents preliminary internal brainstorming only. It must NEVER be cited to donors or in grant proposals.
keyFacts: DO NOT USE IN LIVE SOLICITATIONS OR PROPOSALS.
